dz: 英格兰国王亨利五世在法国和他的儿子亨利六世在9个月大的时候就死于痢疾.
de: King Henry V of England dies of dysentery while in France and his son, Henry VI, becomes king at the age of nine months.

t: 8.8–9.4 Caldera地震震动了智利的阿塔卡马地区,引发了智利,夏威夷和日本的海啸.
te: The 8.8–9.4 Caldera earthquake shakes Chile's Atacama Region causing tsunami in Chile, Hawaii, and Japan.
dz: 8.8–9.4 Caldera地震震动了智利的阿塔卡马地区,引发了智利,夏威夷和日本的海啸.
de: The 8.8–9.4 Caldera earthquake shakes Chile's Atacama Region causing tsunami in Chile, Hawaii, and Japan.

t: 国王哈康五世将挪威首都从卑尔根迁至奥斯陆。
te: King Haakon V moves the capital of Norway from Bergen to Oslo.
dz: 国王哈康五世将挪威首都从卑尔根迁至奥斯陆。
de: King Haakon V moves the capital of Norway from Bergen to Oslo.

t: 阿拉贡的弗雷德里克三世和查理斯,瓦卢瓦伯爵签下"卡尔塔贝略塔之和"(Peace of Calt…
te: Frederick III of Aragon and Charles, Count of Valois sign the Peace of Caltabellotta, which ends the War of the Sicilia…
dz: 阿拉贡的弗雷德里克三世和查理斯,瓦卢瓦伯爵签下"卡尔塔贝略塔之和"(Peace of Caltabellotta),结束了西西里卫斯珀斯之战,将旧西西里王国一分为一和半岛一.
de: Frederick III of Aragon and Charles, Count of Valois sign the Peace of Caltabellotta, which ends the War of the Sicilian Vespers and divides the old Kingdom of Sicily into an island portion and a peninsular portion.

t: 卡米尔成为阿尤布王朝的苏丹。
te: Al-Kamil becomes sultan of the Ayyubid dynasty.
dz: 卡米尔成为阿尤布王朝的苏丹。
de: Al-Kamil becomes sultan of the Ayyubid dynasty.

t: 在突发胃病后,拜占庭皇后西奥多拉无子而死,从而结束了马其顿王朝.
te: After a sudden gastric illness, Byzantine Empress Theodora dies childless, thus ending the Macedonian dynasty.
dz: 在突发胃病后,拜占庭皇后西奥多拉无子而死,从而结束了马其顿王朝.
de: After a sudden gastric illness, Byzantine Empress Theodora dies childless, thus ending the Macedonian dynasty.
